📺 East Los High (2013–2017)

East Los High follows a group of teenagers growing up in East Los Angeles as they navigate complicated relationships, friendships, family expectations, and the challenges of high school life. The story centers on students like Jessie, Maya, Jacob, and Vanessa, whose lives become intertwined through romance, secrets, jealousy, and personal struggles. As they pursue their dreams and deal with difficult decisions, the students face everything from love triangles and heartbreak to family conflicts, betrayal, and intense competition within their school’s dance team. Set against the vibrant culture of East Los Angeles, the series combines emotional storytelling with realistic experiences that reflect the challenges of growing up. Featuring a talented ensemble cast, East Los High delivers unforgettable drama, passionate romances, and heartfelt moments while exploring identity, friendship, loyalty, ambition, and the importance of making choices that shape the future.

🎭 Genre: Teen Drama • Romance • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22–30 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Carlos Portugal & Kathleen Bedoya

📺 Seasons: 4

📚 Setting: East Los Angeles, California
